_note: Single source of truth for blog cluster keys. JSON rather than TypeScript because scripts/prep-blog-og.mjs is plain Node and cannot import a .ts module — that limitation is exactly why this map used to exist in three places, and why the `ads` key went missing from one of them and shipped four posts with the wrong share-card kicker. tsconfig has resolveJsonModule, so the two TS consumers import this directly; the script reads and parses it. Adding a cluster means adding it here and nowhere else. `short` is the marker on the blog index card and the OG card kicker; `long` is the section heading in /llms.txt, deliberately more descriptive because that file is read by machines with no layout constraints. `pillar` is the substantial guide in the cluster that the rest support.
